## Overview

SPIE Defense + Security includes the conference "Infrared Technology and Applications LII" covering IR detector arrays, thermal imaging systems, and SWIR/MWIR/LWIR technologies. Four technical tracks: Materials and Devices, Imaging and Analytics, Advanced Sensing, Next-Gen Sensor Systems.
